info.name: Amazon CloudWatch Create or update a dashboard

params.name: DashboardBody
params.description: The detailed information about the dashboard in JSON format, including the widgets to include and their location on the dashboard

items.docs: Creates a dashboard if it does not already exist, or updates an existing dashboard. If you update a dashboard, the entire contents are replaced with what you specify here. There is no limit to the number of dashboards in your account.

params.name: DashboardName
params.description: The name of the dashboard to retrieve

items.docs: Displays the details of the dashboard that you specify. To copy an existing dashboard, use GetDashboard, and then use the data returned within DashboardBody as the template for the new dashboard.

params.name: NextToken
params.description: Token for the next page of results

items.docs: Returns a list of the dashboards for your account. If you include DashboardNamePrefix, only those dashboards with names starting with the prefix are listed. Otherwise, all dashboards in your account are listed.
